results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if contact scope is required but contact ID unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Find candidate contacts using HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS_BY_CRITERIA (capture candidate IDs; follow paging.next.after).
[Optional (if multiple candidates or to confirm identity)] [Step]: Verify the selected record using HUBSPOT_READ_CONTACT (confirm it’s the intended person; capture final contact ID).
[Required] [Step]: Search email engagements by keyword using HUBSPOT_SEARCH_EMAILS (collect matching engagement/email IDs and minimal preview fields).
[Optional (if results must be limited to one contact)] [Step]: Filter HUBSPOT_SEARCH_EMAILS results client-side to items associated with the chosen contact ID.
[Optional (if paging.next.after present or many matches)] [Next Step]: Paginate HUBSPOT_SEARCH_EMAILS using the after cursor until relevant pages are collected.
[Optional (if you need richer fields/body for a subset)] [Next Step]: Enrich shortlisted items using HUBSPOT_GET_EMAILS (batch) or HUBSPOT_READ_EMAIL (single record).

[Fallback (if HUBSPOT_SEARCH_EMAILS returns no/too few matches)] [Fallback]: Broaden discovery using HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CRM_OBJECTS_BY_CRITERIA (best-fit objectType and optional contact association filter), then inspect candidates with HUBSPOT_READ_EMAIL and/or HUBSPOT_GET_EMAILS.
known_pitfalls: [HUBSPOT_SEARCH_EMAILS] Can succeed but still return results=[] with total=0; treat as “no matches” and broaden via HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CRM_OBJECTS_BY_CRITERIA instead of retrying unchanged.
[HUBSPOT_SEARCH_EMAILS] Returned properties may be null or structured (non-string) values; downstream summarization must tolerate missing/typed fields.
[HUBSPOT_GET_EMAILS] Some engagements have null content fields; fall back to subject and/or html when text-like fields are absent.
[HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS_BY_CRITERIA] Name-based lookup can yield multiple candidates and pagination; response-shape nesting can trip up ID extraction.

[HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CRM_OBJECTS_BY_CRITERIA] Certain date filters (e.g., createdate) may trigger 400 Bad Request; alternative timestamp properties can behave differently—validate semantics before relying on them.
